brief.zh: 完成 weighted_distance(costs, start, goal)。从 [x, y] 起点走到终点，只能上下左右走。0 是墙，正数是进入该格的耗电量。返回最小总耗电量，走不到时返回 None。
brief.en: Complete weighted_distance(costs, start, goal). Move up, down, left, or right from the [x, y] start to the goal. Zero tiles are walls and positive tiles charge their entry cost. Return the minimum energy or None if there is no route.

concept.zh: Dijkstra 按累积代价而不是发现顺序处理待选格
concept.en: Dijkstra expands frontier tiles in order of total cost

hints.zh: frontier 里每项是 [当前代价, x, y]。每轮取出代价最小的一项。
hints.en: Store [cost, x, y] in frontier. Pop the entry with the lowest cost each round.

hints.zh: 用 y * width + x 作格子的键。发现更低代价才加入候选列表。
hints.en: Use y * width + x as the tile key. Add a candidate only when you improve its known cost.

hints.zh: 列表里可能还留着旧的、代价较大的记录。取出后和 best 比一下，就能跳过这些旧记录。
hints.en: The frontier may still contain old, costlier entries. Compare a popped entry with best to skip stale work.

label.en: Skip old entries and check the goal
